Backing samples in this folder

drums/*.wav  Extracted from FluidR3_GM.sf2 (Brush kit, bank 128 program 40):
             ride, ride2, hi-hat foot, kick, brush tap, brush swirl. Mono, trimmed, normalised.
bass/*.mp3   Acoustic Bass (GM 33) notes D1-C4 from the MIDI.js soundfont rendering of
             FluidR3_GM (https://github.com/gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts), decoded from base64.
